newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 1997 budget draft pleases labour minister.
newsitem.headline: Polish 1997 budget draft pleases labour minister.

text.p: Poland's Labour Minster on Wednesday said he was pleased with the government's 1997 budget proposal, which plans to increase his ministry's budget by two percent in real terms to 19.6 billion zlotys.
"This is the best budget in several years...the labour ministry's expenditures constitute nearly 15.5 percent of the country's spending in 1997," Andrzej Baczkowski told a news conference.

Government subsidies to the country's ailing Social Security Fund (FUS) will make up 29 percent of the ministry's spending next year, a labour ministry report said. It said however, that FUS's subsidies decreased 1.5 percent from 1995.
